summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 20 yen per share from 18 yen; full-year dividend raised to 40 yen per share from 36 yen, an increase of 4 yen per share for fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend and Revision of Full-Year Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Viken Techno raised its interim dividend to 20 yen per share from the previously forecast 18 yen, effective December 9, 2026, based on a record date of September 30, 2026. The company simultaneously revised upward its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, increasing the year-end dividend to 20 yen per share from the forecast 18 yen. Combined with the interim dividend, the full-year dividend is now projected at 40 yen per share, compared to the previous forecast of 36 yen per share, representing an increase of 4 yen per share.

The company stated that the dividend decision reflects comprehensive consideration of current business performance trends, future capital requirements, and the need to strengthen its financial position while maintaining stable dividends. The policy emphasizes a balance between returning value to shareholders through consistent payouts and preserving internal reserves to support corporate strengthening and future business expansion.
